title: Undertow and Aftermath
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Xanthe Whitlock, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
